Subject: Internal: Cardinal Health sampling + redaction plan (SAML/SCIM/RBAC)

Team — internal plan for the Cardinal ask:

Sampling criteria:
- SAML: pull assertions covering last 90 days; pick 6 total (3 SP-initiated, 3 IdP-initiated). Prioritize flows that include role attributes and have unique Assertion IDs.
- SCIM: export a rolling 90-day delta log, then sample 200 events with at least 30 group membership changes and 20 service-account events.
- RBAC owners: generate full CSV, then redaction-safe CSV for sharing. We will mark owner emails as hashed in the shared CSV but include a mapping key in the secure drive for auditor use (access-controlled).

Redaction approach:
- NameID: keep domain, mask local part (e.g., #####@example.com).
- Timestamps / assertion IDs / role names: preserve verbatim.
- Service account IDs: preserve, but flag as SERVICE_ACCOUNT in the account_type column.

Attachments to prepare (stubs): saml-assertion-sample.txt (6 assertions, redacted), scim-delta-samples.csv (200 rows), rbac-owner-map.csv (redacted + mapping key in protected drive).

I’ll stage the files in a restricted Drive folder and share a short-lived link (see drive link below). Laura — can you confirm format for RBAC CSV and run the redaction job?

Irene Choi
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
